Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, 'Saudamini', Plot No.2, Sector 29, Gurgaon - 122001, Haryana. .Respondents ORDER The Petitioner, Bijapur REZ Transmission Limited (now known as Bijapur REZ Transmission Private Limited), has filed the present Regulatory Compliance Application seeking approval to change the name of the Transmission Licensee from “Bijapur REZ Transmission Limited” To “Bijapur REZ Transmission Private Limited”. The Petitioner has made the following prayer: “(a) Allow the present petition; (b) Take on record the change in name of the transmission licensee/ Petitioner from “Bijapur REZ Transmission Limited” to “Bijapur REZ Transmission Private Limited”, in terms as stated in the present Petition; (c) Direct that necessary endorsement be made on the transmission licensee with regard to change of name of “Bijapur REZ Transmission Limited” to “Bijapur REZ Transmission Private Limited”; (d) Pass necessary orders to ensure that no prejudice is caused to the Petitioner on account of the above name change; and (e) Pass any such further/other orders that this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit in the interest of equity and justice.” 2. By order dated 21.1.2025 in Petition No. 247/TL/2025, Bijapur REZ Transmission Limited (BREZTL) was granted an inter-State transmission licence Order in Petition No. 570/RC/2026 Page 3 bearing License No. 171/Transmission/2025/CERC, to implement the inter-State transmission system, namely “Transmission Scheme for integration of Bijapur REZ in Karnataka”. 3. The Petitioner has submitted that an application under Section 14(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 41 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014 was filed before the Regional Director (WR), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai, seeking approval for the conversion of the company into a Private Limited Company, which was duly approved vide Order dated 26.5.2026 by the Regional Director. Thereafter, the Regional Director sanctioned the alteration of Clause I of the Memorandum of Association, i.e. “Bijapur REZ Transmission Limited” to “Bijapur REZ Transmission Private Limited”. 4. Subsequently, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs also issued a Certificate of Incorporation dated 29.6.2026 consequent upon conversion to a private company, duly recording the aforesaid conversion. 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, consequent to the change in name of the transmission licensee, i.e., the Petitioner, there has been no change in the composition or structure of the company. Analysis and Decision 6. This Petition is being decided by way of circulation. 7. We have considered the submission of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Petitioner was granted the transmission license vide order dated 8.6.2025 in Petition No. 247/TL/2025. Order in Petition No. 570/RC/2026 Page 4
